purpose: Define database-style records for monthly product trend intelligence and dashboard reporting.

definitions.trend_signal: Evidence that a product or category may be gaining, holding, or losing demand.
definitions.product_opportunity: A product idea scored for sampling or rejection.
definitions.dashboard_metric: A saved number used in a report or dashboard.

data_quality_rules: Every trend signal needs source, market, date, metric, and score.
Every monthly report needs a source summary.
Every product opportunity needs a decision label.
Internal category share must not be labelled as global market share.
